name: Sales Deck
description: Structured sales presentation with slide-based layout for B2B sales meetings.
prompt_template:
Generate a sales deck for {house_name} using the messaging framework below.

GROUNDING CONTEXT:
{context}

Generate exactly 7 slides as a JSON array. Each slide must have:
- "layout": one of ["title", "agenda", "content", "side_by_side", "quote", "closing"]
- "heading": slide heading (max 8 words)
- "content": array of strings (bullet points or paragraphs)
- "notes": speaker notes (2-3 sentences for the presenter)
- "image_prompt": optional description for a visual placeholder

Slide structure:
1. Title Slide — company name, tagline, presenter name placeholder
2. Agenda — 4-6 agenda items from the framework
3. Problem/Pain — top 3 pain points from personas
4. Solution Overview — positioning + top 3 key messages
5. Why Us — differentiation points with proof
6. Social Proof — testimonial/results placeholder + key proof points
7. Next Steps — 3 concrete action items

Output ONLY valid JSON array. No markdown fences. Example:
[
  {"layout":"title","heading":"...","content":["..."],"notes":"...","image_prompt":"..."},
  ...
]
